lead: A `loop-goal.toml` `nvs-suite` check's `cases` are drafted names, and a case can be on disk under the name its author chose.
body: Eight of goal `webcrypto`'s stage 4 paths read "not written yet" against green cases, because no check named the tree's own spellings — `crypto-public-key-round-trips-every-kind-through-every-encoding.nvst` is the check's `crypto-public-keys-read-raw-spki-and-jwk-and-write-them-back.nvst`. List the directory for that member and compare `--TEST--` lines before writing anything: where the tree holds the claim the repair is the name in the goal file, and where it holds half of it the drafted case is real work.
